Cammareri Bros. rosemary focaccia.d: From a Brooklyn baker, dimpled with olive oil and coarse salt. Cut by hand.
Cammareri Bros. rosemary focaccia.note: Over the bridge from Ronny's ovens every afternoon.

Eggs in the hole.d: White toast fried in butter, an egg set in a ring of red pepper, yolk soft.

Chicken scaloppine.d: Pounded thin, floured and sautéed, with lemon, white wine, capers and butter.
Chicken scaloppine.note: Secondi served with a green salad.

Cannoli.d: Ricotta, sugar and orange zest in chocolate dipped shells, filled to order.

Brooklyn amaretto sours.d: Shaken frothy with lemon and egg white, over ice, a cherry on top.
